parsed.name: FTP上传组件
parsed.description: 用于将本地实验数据文件通过FTP上传到远程服务器的非物理软件组件，主要负责文件传输流程与连接调用。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that uploads local experiment data files to a remote server over FTP, focusing on transfer flow and connection calls.

actions.description: 将文件上传到远程 FTP 路径。
actions.description_en: Upload a file to a remote FTP path.
